brief: A kitchen garden terrace by a sunny back door: three rows of four planters stepping up one, two and three storeys from front to back, so no row shades the row in front of it. Back row, full-size greens: kale, romaine, chard and bok choy. Middle row, herbs: basil, parsley, mint and chives. Front row: strawberries in two planters, a nasturtium and a marigold. Fill every planter with soil and plant it. Put the one-storey row nearest the default view and the tall greens farthest from it, and use look to check that every plant is visible from that view.

finish.summary: Stepped terrace: front row (r=1, 1 storey) strawberries/nasturtium/marigold, middle (r=0, 2 storeys) herbs, back (r=-1, 3 storeys) full-size greens. 12 drained bins filled with soil and planted at harvest stage. House rules applied, mesh clear, default view sees all 12 plants.

Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
